messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands security segment. a couple of customers asked for a short public-friendly timeline for SOC2/ISO artifacts, BYOK for EU, and VPC private control plane availability.

 tara (Security): thanks for raising. high level: SOC2 evidence automation is our immediate priority, BYOK (key import + integrations) is staged after that, and private control plane (VPC) is later in the roadmap. i’ll post a compact timeline in the follow-up doc.

 samir: can we confirm if audit logs will be exportable per-org, and whether retention can be set by customer? some buyers want >=1yr retention and S3 archiving.

 dev-platform: yes — export paths we're building: daily S3 snapshot, real-time syslog/webhook, and a managed archive tier. retention will be configurable at the org level in the console and via API. early beta next month. example API request to enable streaming: 

```
POST /orgs/{org_id}/audit-stream
{"dest":"syslog://logs.acme.example:514","format":"rfc5424"}
```

 maria: will exported logs include request/response payloads? our security team is asking about default redaction levels.

 tara (Security): default exports will redact sensitive fields (PII) in data-plane traces. for compliance engagements/auditors we have an audited unredacted bundle workflow (requires signed NDA and access approvals). all downloads are logged and retained.

 leo (Solutions): on SOC2 vs ISO: customers keep asking what controls are in scope. can we publish a short matrix we can hand to procurement?

 tara (Security): yes. scope matrix + control mapping will be part of the evidence pack. pack contents (draft): control owners list, infra config snapshots, IAM rosters, build/deploy trails, sample logs, and automated evidence links. we’re validating with our external assessor to make sure format is auditor-friendly.

 olivia: any concrete dates for comms? sales needs something they can put in RFPs.

 tara (Security): targets (subject to change): evidence pack + compliance UI improvements: end of Q2 (June). KMS BYOK import beta (EU): late Q3 (Aug-Sept). cross-account KMS/HSM integrations and rotation APIs: Q4. VPC private control plane GA: Q4 end. audit-export streaming beta: early next month (May). i’ll mark these as tentative in the follow-up.

 samir: for BYOK, whats the customer experience for key rotation and emergency key-revocation? do we support customer-controlled rotation?

 tara (Security): two modes: managed keys (we can auto-rotate) and imported/customer keys (rotation controlled by customer). we'll provide rotation APIs, CLI, and a recommended rotation cadence guide. emergency revoke will trigger immediate block and a key-state audit.

 dev-platform: note for product folks: some customers want direct HSM-backed decryption inside their VPC. that's an architectural ask we’re scoping as a private-deploy option.

 maria: can someone create a customer-facing one-pager and a short FAQ we can share? sales wants both by next Friday.

 compliance-bot: @maria created ticket COMP-601: "SOC2/ISO evidence matrix + BYOK & VPC customer FAQ" assigned to @maria and @leo, due 2026-05-08.

 leo (Solutions): i'll draft slides once the one-pager lands. happy to help tune language for procurement.

 olivia: great. tara, can you drop the bullet roadmap + any risks into the all-hands follow-up doc so i can include in the summary email?

 tara (Security): will post a short bullet list in ~30 minutes and ping leadership. also open to pairing with engineering to firm dates. :+1:

 samir: last Q — will audit exports be priced separately, or included in hosted tiers?

 dev-platform: export/storage bandwidth will be included for X GB per month; overage pricing TBD. we'll include pricing guidance in the beta docs.

 olivia: thanks everyone. this clarifies customer asks and next steps.
